readerCopy.body: A disagreement changes once one side can freeze the deal, withhold access, or make a decision that materially narrows the other's options. When the Sun opposes Pluto, purpose meets concentrated power, making pride and dependence easy to confuse with the original issue. Arguing harder does not make unequal leverage equal. The conflict becomes clearer when the remaining alternatives, outside sources of authority, and conditions that could reduce dependence are brought into view.
